process_issues.description: Round 2 re-ask on the same head (07bd50d3) reviewed in round 1; prior record held no importants. Skipped by gate: security (no trust boundary touched), context (no spec/protocol/infra surface), guards (only a test file changed), workflow-safety (no workflow change), maintainability (off the default roster), spec (no closing issue or spec source).

Dropped both simplicity nits at consolidation. (1) Removing answer's per-field query filter would bring back the lastEditedAt mutant the PR exists to kill, and the reviewer itself called the filter a deliberate choice. Its caveat that `\blabels\b` matches `label` is wrong; correctness verified that it does not. (2) The reviewer's own verdict on the `labelled` closure was 'keep'. No consolidator was spawned because no findings were left.
